Q8128.reason: Exercise-triggered cough that stops with rest plus a family history of asthma is exercise-induced asthma, which often has normal resting spirometry; chronic bronchitis does not fit a young nonsmoker.

Q5479.reason: Solicitation was complete when she requested the murder, while common-law conspiracy requires a genuine agreement and fails when the agent only feigned assent; later renunciation is no defense.
